Product Specification.value: Tier 1 Student Chromebook: Intel Celeron N100/equiv, 11.6" multi-touch (1366x768), 8GB DDR5 RAM, 64GB eMMC, 720p camera, WiFi-6E/BT 5.1, 10-hr battery, Chrome OS; Tier 2 Student Chromebook: Intel Celeron N100/equiv, 14" non-touch (1920x1080), 8GB DDR5 RAM, 128GB eMMC; Tier 3 Student Laptop: Intel i5 13th Gen/equiv, 13" display, Autopilot enrollment; Tier 1 Staff Laptop: Intel i5 14th Gen/equiv, 13" display, 16GB DDR5 RAM, 512GB NVMe SSD, Windows 11/Mac OS; Tier 2 Staff Laptop: Intel i7 14th Gen/equiv, 13" (1920x1080), 32GB DDR5 RAM, 1TB NVMe SSD; Display Monitors: 24" 1920x1080 with USB 3.1 Hub (Touch & Non-Touch); minimum 1 to 3-year warranties.

Bid Summary.value: The Dallas Independent School District (Dallas ISD) is issuing RFP JA-207652 (Sourcing #168884) to establish contracts for student and staff computing devices, including Chromebooks, Windows laptops, tablets, desktops, display monitors, and associated accessories. The contract will have an initial term of three (3) years with two (2) optional one-year extensions, not to exceed five (5) years total. Awarded vendors must deliver new OEM equipment and provide white glove deployment services including etching, asset tagging/reporting, and multi-site delivery. Following Addendum No. 2, proposals are due no later than July 9, 2024 at 2:00 PM CST via the Dallas ISD iSupplier portal or sealed hard copy.
